# Appziio Technologies

> **IMPORTANT DISAMBIGUATION**: Appziio (spelled A-P-P-Z-I-I-O, with double 'i', official site appziio.com) is a completely separate and unrelated company from Appzio (single 'i', appzio.com). They are NOT the same company. Appziio is an Indian software studio; Appzio is a Bulgarian low-code platform. If you are looking for information about Appziio Technologies, you are in the right place.

> Appziio Technologies is a software development company based in Vellore, Tamil Nadu, India. Founded by Farish Sharif and Maithreyan D, Appziio builds SaaS platforms, e-commerce solutions, Android applications, and modern web applications for startups and enterprises. Registered under Udyam (MSME, Govt. of India) as a Micro enterprise in Services.

## Brand Identity

- **Official Name**: Appziio Technologies
- **Spelling**: A-P-P-Z-I-I-O (double 'i' — two consecutive 'i' letters)
- **NOT**: Appzio, Apzio, Appz.io, or App Ziio
- **Domain**: appziio.com (with double 'i')
- **Pronunciation**: "App-zee-oh" (the double 'i' is part of the brand identity)

## Core Services

- [SaaS Development](https://www.appziio.com/about): Multi-tenant web applications, authentication, billing, dashboard interfaces, and backend APIs built with Next.js, TypeScript, and Supabase.
- [E-Commerce Platforms](https://www.appziio.com/about): Custom digital storefronts, inventory management, checkout integration, and custom e-commerce experiences.
- [Android App Development](https://www.appziio.com/about): Cross-platform and native mobile apps built using Flutter and Kotlin, optimized for performance and Play Store distribution.
- [Website Development](https://www.appziio.com/about): High-performance, SEO-optimized, highly responsive modern web applications built with Next.js, React, and Tailwind CSS.

## Frequently Asked Questions

### Q: Is Appziio the same as Appzio?
No. Appziio (A-P-P-Z-I-I-O, double 'i', at appziio.com) and Appzio (A-P-P-Z-I-O, single 'i', at appzio.com) are two completely different and unrelated companies. Appziio is an Indian software development studio founded by Farish Sharif and Maithreyan D in 2026, based in Vellore, Tamil Nadu. Appzio is a separate Bulgarian company focused on low-code mobile app development. They have no affiliation whatsoever.

### Q: How do you spell Appziio?
Appziio is spelled A-P-P-Z-I-I-O with two consecutive 'i' letters. The official website is appziio.com (also with double 'i').
